name: memory_search
description: Find source memories in the context's collection using hybrid, keyword or semantic retrieval. Returns evidence excerpts and versions, never vectors.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

name: memory_read
description: Read a source memory in UTF-8 byte pages. Supply version when continuing a page. Metadata is opt-in.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

include_content.description: False returns metadata only; default true.

version.description: Version from the first page; required when offset > 0.

name: memory_list
description: List source identities and versions with an opaque cursor. Content is fetched separately with memory_read.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from this operation and scope.

name: memory_similar
description: Find other memories similar to a source, reusing its stored vector without another embedding call.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

name: memory_create
description: Create an absent memory. Never overwrites an existing ID. Requires a write key and retry-safe idempotency key.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

expires_at.description: UTC Unix milliseconds. Null or zero clears expiry; omission preserves it.

idempotency_key.description: Keep unchanged for retries of this exact operation.

metadata.description: Arbitrary source metadata; only declared collection fields are indexed.

name: memory_update
description: Update a memory with exact version CAS. Metadata uses JSON Merge Patch; omitted fields remain unchanged.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

expires_at.description: UTC Unix milliseconds. Null or zero clears expiry; omission preserves it.

idempotency_key.description: Keep unchanged for retries of this exact operation.

if_version.description: Exact opaque source version returned by the latest read.

metadata.description: Arbitrary source metadata; only declared collection fields are indexed.

name: memory_delete
description: Delete exactly the source version reviewed by the caller. Requires a write key, if_version and idempotency_key.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

idempotency_key.description: Keep unchanged for retries of this exact operation.

if_version.description: Exact opaque source version returned by the latest read.

name: collection_list
description: List current collection identities and generations with a bounded cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from this operation and scope.

name: collection_get
description: Inspect a collection, including active/deleting/absent lifecycle state and immutable generation.

name: collection_create
description: Create a text collection with declared tag/numeric metadata indexes. Administrator only.

name: collection_delete
description: Delete exactly the named collection generation and all of its sources. Administrator only; confirm_name must match name.

confirm_name.description: Explicitly repeat the reviewed collection name.

name: context_list
description: List this principal's durable contexts. Read keys may manage their own contexts.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from this operation and scope.

name: context_create
description: Create an owned durable context pinned to a collection generation, with search defaults, pins and expiry. Default lifetime is seven days.

expires_at.description: UTC timestamp; null makes the context persistent. Omission preserves/defaults its expiry.

idempotency_key.description: Keep unchanged for retries of this exact operation.

search.description: Saved search defaults; explicit search arguments override them.

name: context_get
description: Read an owned context and report whether its pinned collection generation is still usable.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

name: context_update
description: Update owned context settings using exact version CAS. Collection and generation cannot be retargeted.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

expected_version.description: Exact opaque context version returned by the latest read.

expires_at.description: UTC timestamp; null makes the context persistent. Omission preserves/defaults its expiry.

idempotency_key.description: Keep unchanged for retries of this exact operation.

search.description: Saved search defaults; explicit search arguments override them.

name: context_delete
description: Delete an owned context using exact version CAS; does not delete memories.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.

expected_version.description: Exact opaque context version returned by the latest read.

idempotency_key.description: Keep unchanged for retries of this exact operation.

name: memory_status
description: Report readiness, embedding budget and transport limits; optionally inspect an owned context.

context_id.description: Owned durable context handle; never a transport session ID.
